leads.title: Malawi Penal Code - Sections 153, 154, 156 (and 137A / Section 28)
leads.documents: Primary criminal law criminalizing same-sex sexual activity: carnal knowledge against order of nature (14 years), attempts (7 years), gross indecency between males (5 years) and between females (5 years).
leads.detail: Cited in text as Sec. 153(a)(c), 154, 156, 137A for female same-sex, Sec. 28; no URL visible in article text

leads.title: Marriage, Divorce and Family Relations Law (2015)
leads.documents: Bans all same-sex marriages and unions; states gender is assigned at birth and bars post-reassignment marriage recognition.
leads.detail: Cited as came into force 17 April 2015; no URL visible in article text

leads.title: Communications (Broadcasting) Regulations 2019 - Sections 22(1-d) and 30(2-d)
leads.documents: Limited hate-speech/broadcast protection covering gender identity and sexual preference.
leads.detail: Quoted definition of 'hate messages' and Sec. 22(1-d), 30(2-d); no URL visible

leads.title: Republic v. Tiwonge Chimbalanga and Steven Monjeza - Criminal Case No. 359 of 2009, Blantyre Magistrates Court
leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: arrest Dec 2009 after engagement ceremony, conviction 18-20 May 2010 for unnatural offences/indecent practices between males, 14 years hard labour, pardon 29 May 2010 by President Bingu wa Mutharika.
leads.detail: Case number 359 of 2009; Magistrate Nyakwawa Usiwausiwa; High Court Chief Justice Lovemore G. Munlo ruling 22 Feb 2010 denying Constitutional Court referral; no URL visible

leads.title: Magistrate's Court in Mangochi - Jana Gonani conviction, 23 Dec 2021
leads.documents: Documented incident against trans woman: conviction under section 153(c) for unnatural offences, 8 years imprisonment.
leads.detail: Dated 23 December 2021, Section 153(c); later consolidated for constitutional referral; no URL visible

leads.title: High Court of Malawi sitting as Constitutional Court - 28 June 2024 judgment (Gonani / Jan Willem Akster petitions)
leads.documents: Court ruling upholding constitutionality of Penal Code sections 153, 154 and 156, confirming validity of convictions for consensual same-sex conduct.
leads.detail: Dated 28 June 2024; rejects discrimination claim; no URL visible

leads.title: High Court in Mzuzu - Moratorium litigation, Feb 2016
leads.documents: Rights machinery/enforcement status: 9 Feb 2016 injunction ordering police/DPP to resume arrests, 19 Feb 2016 annulment of executive moratorium as unconstitutional.
leads.detail: Followed Attorney General Ralph Kasambara 5 Nov 2012 moratorium and Justice Minister Samuel Tembenu reaffirmations July 2014 and 18 Dec 2015; no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2011 Human Rights Report on Malawi
leads.documents: Government report documenting state-driven homophobic environment, senior officials' statements including Tourism Minister Daniel Liwimbi Sept 2011 remarks.
leads.detail: Cited as 'U.S. Department of State's 2011 human rights report'; no URL visible

leads.title: Human Rights Watch - October 2018 report on Malawi
leads.documents: Human-rights report finding LGBTQ community vulnerable to arbitrary arrest, physical violence and discrimination; recommends decriminalisation.
leads.detail: Dated October 2018; also cited 6 Nov 2012 HRW welcome of moratorium; no URL visible

leads.title: United Nations Human Rights Committee - Provisional Concluding Observations June 2012 and Malawi Initial Report 13 July 2012; UN Human Rights Council Universal Periodic Review March 2011
leads.documents: International rights machinery: concern over secs 153,156,137A, violence/discrimination and incitement by officials; Malawi response referring laws to Law Commission; UPR recommendations from Sweden, Mexico, France, US and others to decriminalize.
leads.detail: ICCPR party since 22 Dec 1993, Art.40; Malawi delegation oral response citing Law Commission review; no URL visible
